Add candidate (bottom of Applied, email shape, case-insensitive duplicate per job, field-level error, typed values kept): index.js:216-233, board.js:41-60. (4) Moves one stage at a time with ordinary controls (select+Move, Up/Down), reject needs reason, Hired cannot be rejected, reopen only to rejected_from and clears reason, drag optional: index.js:238-271, board.js:144-162, 208-244, 300-319. (5) Shared hand order persisted in positions: index.js:199-200, 297-318. Interview cap, reorder inside always fine, freed place usable: index.js:290-295. (6) Role limits (HM own job, Interview/Offer/Hired, reject from Interview/Offer, reopen those): index.js:257-264. Observer/candidate cannot move: index.js:326-333; observer UI offers no write controls: board.js:267-269, threads.js:140-142. (7) Version-based 409 naming who changed the card (last activity line), board re-read: index.js:241-245; optimistic move, put back, reason shown, focus kept on card controls: board.js:166-205. (8) Bulk move in board order (stage then place), rules per card, places counted for the set, all-or-nothing in one IMMEDIATE transaction: index.js:274-321, 339-344, board.js:277-290. (9) Undo own latest move, single or bulk; restores stage, place and reason; refused if any card's version changed or Interview would overfill; once only; superseded by a later move: index.js:165-168, 348-373, board.js:291-299. (10) Card detail with internal notes, note permissions, unsaved note kept per person in localStorage: index.js:386-398, board.js:85-141. (11) Activity: job opening, add, move, reject with reason, reopen, reorder, undo as readable lines; append-only; refusals roll back inside the transaction; newest first; all jobs or one job: index.js:195-198, 211, 230, 266-271, 315-316, 366, app.js:80-120. (12) Live updates via SSE 'changed' after successful writes (including read markers), keyed in-place patching keeps open card, note draft, focus and scroll: index.js:45-54, 102-107, app.js:165-199, board.js:321-341. (13) Conversations with role access, plain text with line breaks (styles.css:105 pre-wrap), Enter sends / Shift+Enter newline, box emptied and refocused, failed send kept and reported: index.js:114-131, 418-429, threads.js:182-201. (14) Latest 30 opened at the newest, earlier 30 at a time with remaining count and scroll anchor kept: index.js:401-417, threads.js:85-87, 160-175. Arrival while scrolled up keeps place, shows 'N new messages', stays unread: threads.js:145-159, 176-181. (15) Per-person unread counts (own never unread, sending counts as reading), per conversation and total badge: index.js:132-139, 423-427, threads.js:44-57, 221, app.js:150-156. Seen receipt on my latest message, boundary candidate vs recruiter-or-job-HM, observer never counts: index.js:143-156, threads.js:76-83. (16) Drafts per person and conversation in localStorage keyed by user id, kept across switch, view change, reload and session end; a 401 triggers the sign-in prompt with email prefilled; another user on the browser cannot see them: app.js:61-78, 222-230, threads.js:112, 124, 182. (17) Candidate privacy: candidate bootstrap excludes stage, position, notes, reason and others; staff endpoints answer 403/404 for candidates: index.js:171-176, 378-390. Seed copy is hash-identical to /assets; every read_count is within 1..message count so seeding cannot fail.
